normal.text: "When was the first time you killed a man?" *slow drag on cigarette, distant look in eyes* "... it was the days of DOS text parser adventure games. King's Quest 2. The church." "No. You typed...?" "Yes. 'kill monk'."

normal.name: Brenden
normal.text: Many retro game folks are aware of Tengen's version of Tetris for NES and the infamous story surrounding it, but did you know they were actually planning on releasing it as an officially licensed Nintendo game? Box art for the licensed version can be seen in early print ads before Tengen went rogue.
